subject: Re: Follow-up: Security & Data Residency — EU availability and export controls
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Security & Data Residency — EU availability and export controls

Hi Anna — thanks again for the intro call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps on the security/data residency items you raised: 

Recap from our call:
- You need production data stored in the EU for this workload (primary region preference: Frankfurt).
- You asked about SOC 2 status, GDPR controls, HIPAA applicability, and vendor screening (questionnaire).
- You also want clarity on cross-border transfers (how we handle data exports) and export-control screen checks (OFAC/ITAR).

What I can share immediately:
- Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report (we can share a summary and a redacted report under NDA). See attached: redwood_SOC2_summary_2025.pdf (attachment stub).
- We support EU-hosted deployments (we have Frankfurt and Amsterdam regions; for Dedicated/Private we can ensure data never leaves the customer VPC).
- Cross-border transfers: our hosted offering stores customer data in-region by default; exports occur only per customer-configured export policies or administrative actions. We can outline technical controls and contractual data transfer language for GDPR.
- Export controls / sanctions screening: we perform OFAC screening on customer account sign-ups and have processes to escalate potential ITAR concerns to our compliance team. We'll need a little more detail on whether your workload contains ITAR-controlled data.

Proposed next steps:
1) Please send over your vendor security questionnaire (you mentioned an XLSX) — we can start filling it out and loop in Rishi (security) to provide technical responses.
2) If you want the SOC 2 report redacted, let me know and we can provide it via a secure Drive link after an NDA (I can initiate).
3) I recommend a 30-min technical follow-up with Rishi and your security lead to go through the questionnaire and the EU deployment model. Are you available Thurs or next Monday?

Let me know and I’ll send calendar invites.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Hi Marissa — thanks for the summary and the SOC2 summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Acme requires production data to remain in the EU (we prefer DE-FRA). Any backups or DR copies must also be stored in-region unless we have a documented and approved cross-border transfer mechanism.
- We will need the following from Redwood to proceed: redacted SOC 2 Type II report (or a secure summary), evidence of GDPR controls (DPIA/processing details), and answers to our vendor security questionnaire.
- Regarding export controls/OFAC/ITAR: our legal team needs confirmation that Redwood performs sanctions screening on users/accounts and a statement on whether Redwood ever exports controlled technical data outside the EU in a way that would trigger ITAR. If ITAR applies to our payloads, we'll need to understand your export-control compliance model.

I'm attaching our vendor questionnaire (Acme_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_2026.xlsx). Please have Rishi complete the technical sections.

Availability: Thurs Mar 12 09:00–11:00 CET or Mon Mar 16 14:00–16:00 CET for the technical call.

Thanks,
Anna
Head of Security & Compliance | Acme EU GmbH
anna.schmidt@acme-eu.com

Hi Anna — great, thanks. Per your ask: 

- I've attached the SOC 2 summary in this thread (redwood_SOC2_summary_2025.pdf). If you want the full redacted Type II report we can share it via a secure Drive link after a simple NDA; happy to initiate that if helpful.
- Rishi — can you take ownership of the questionnaire? The attached Acme XLSX contains the sections marked TECHNICAL that need your input.
- On EU hosting: our hosted product can be pinned to the Frankfurt region for your tenant; for Dedicated/Private deployments we can guarantee no egress from your VPC. I'll include the public doc for our EU region here: https://redwood.ai/docs/eu-data-residency
- On export controls: at a high level we run sanctions screening during onboarding and have controls for account-level restrictions. ITAR is not commonly applicable to our standard hosted model, but if Acme's payloads are ITAR-controlled we should treat that as a requirement for a Dedicated/Private deployment and escalate to our legal/compliance team.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Rishi to complete the technical sections of the questionnaire (ETA: EOD Fri Mar 13 PT)
2) I will start the NDA process so we can share a redacted SOC 2 Type II report if required
3) Schedule 30-min technical call: Anna proposed Thu Mar 12 09:00–11:00 CET — that maps to Thu Mar 11 23:00–01:00 PT. If that window works, I can invite; alternatively propose Mon Mar 16 14:00–16:00 CET.

Anna — do you prefer the Thu slot (we can do it late here) or should we pick Mon?

Thanks,
Marissa
